output.retrospective:
## What went well
Independent exact-head review caught unsupported historical shapes and the realistic remaining-history refusal before accepting PR #730. The final review reports a 128,836-byte working view, 28 retrievable original answers and 64 unchanged current files. Fresh implementation receipts and merged-revision CI preserve the distinction between source proof, acceptance and integration.

## What went wrong
Earlier fixtures covered documents but understated non-file decision history; passing checks therefore did not establish the intended continuation (reviews 5930855634 and 5932246179). Recovery comments also report retention admission failures and an evidence collection refusal at 201 files (comment 6939687329); those failed attempts remain failures. The current review lacks provider-bound test evidence and an external-evidence verification receipt. These are process/evidence gaps, separate from the source defects now recorded as fixed. No new source defect or conflicting affected guidance was established in this focused review. Retries within #722 do not establish recurrence across work items; costs and attention time are unknown.

## Start doing
Carry combined aliases, mixed envelopes, older versions and realistically sized decision prose through the real preparation and adapter boundaries from the first correction. Keep test outcomes, exact source/model identities and provider-generated citations together in the bounded review evidence. Owners: SDLC test maintainer and verification maintainer.

## Stop doing
Treating green CI, a configured tool receipt or a smaller synthetic fixture as installed native acceptance. Stop treating a successful citation command as proof that test-outcome evidence was validated. Preserve historical failures rather than relabelling later recovery as their success. Owner: delivery reviewer.

## Improvement candidates
- **Representative-history regression (source/test learning):** earlier candidates refused mixed histories and a 414,888-byte ordinary view despite passing checks (reviews 5930855634/5932246179). Owner: SDLC test maintainer. Smallest useful guard: retain the combined 320-KiB decision-history fixture at preparation, projection and composition boundaries, including exhaustive body and 64-file hash assertions. Reproduction-before-correction is the public combined-history extension in review 5932246179; corrected assertions are in product-context.test.mjs:388-475 and opencode-execute.test.mjs:155-227. Existing source checks support the correction; any additional guard needs its own review and unchanged-test RED/GREEN proof.
- **Bounded evidence inventory (process, deferred):** owner comment 6939687329 reports collection stopped at 201 files. Owner: workflow evidence maintainer. Smallest proposed guard: measure the final evidence inventory before handoff and keep scratch trees out while preserving all required receipts in a bounded report/manifest. Before adopting a new guard, reproduce the collection refusal with synthetic over-bound evidence, then prove legal bundling preserves every required outcome and still refuses excess. No new guard or policy change was implemented or qualified here.
- **Provider-bound review bundle (current blocker):** supplied receipts cover repository/citation/plan checks but omit the verification document and evidence-verify outcome required by product-verification.md:26-32. Owner: verification maintainer. Smallest useful guard: include that document, model binding and completed diagnostics in the existing bounded evidence handoff. Reproduce a missing/mismatched-evidence review, then demonstrate a separately reviewed correction accepts current matching evidence while preserving stale/failed outcomes and rejecting omissions. No permission expansion or new mandatory forge check is proposed.

Protected publication, clean-consumer adoption and installed native qualification remain owned follow-ups under #722, not accomplishments of this review.
